name: apple-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Apple Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, Mail, and iMessage. One tool per app, each with an `action` parameter. Reading Mail and iMessage requires Full Disk Access.

tools.name: calendar
tools.description: Read and manage Calendar.app events. Actions: list_calendars, list_events, search_events, get_event, create_event, update_event, delete_event (confirm=true).

tools.name: reminders
tools.description: Read and manage Reminders.app. Actions: list_lists, list, search, create, update, complete, delete (confirm=true), create_list.

tools.name: contacts
tools.description: Read and manage Contacts.app. Actions: search, get, create, update, delete (confirm=true).

tools.name: mail
tools.description: Read and manage Mail.app email. Actions: list_accounts, list_mailboxes, list_messages, search, get, send (confirm=true), create_draft, mark, delete (confirm=true). Reading uses Mail's index (Full Disk Access).

tools.name: imessage
tools.description: Read and send iMessage/SMS via Messages.app. Actions: list_chats, list_messages, search, send (confirm=true). Reading requires Full Disk Access.
